blocks.text: Rizal Commercial Banking Corp. (RCBC) is encouraging depositors to take a closer look at their savings and spending habits as food, fuel, and utility costs remain elevated. Oil price volatility continues to affect transport and power bills, while weather-driven supply disruptions have kept prices of staple goods like rice and vegetables higher than usual. RCBC said the environment calls for a more deliberate approach to personal finance. “This is a good time to review how your money is working for you. Small, practical adjustments like putting idle cash to work, managing spending more strategically, and making the most of the benefits […]...
